# Wilson Kumalo — Software & Systems Engineer

Wilson Kumalo is a Zimbabwean software and systems engineer specialising in digital health, offline-first architecture, data integration and platform engineering across mobile, web and backend systems.

## Professional focus

- Digital health and clinical software
- Offline-first architecture and data synchronisation
- Health-data interoperability, including EHR and DHIS2 workflows
- Multi-portal and multi-tenant platforms
- Mobile, web, backend and deployment infrastructure
- Education technology for low-connectivity environments

## Selected case studies

- Neotree digital health platform: https://wilsonkumalo.dev/work/neotree
- Neotree, Impilo and DHIS2 interoperability: https://wilsonkumalo.dev/work/health-interoperability
- Distributed Android application updates: https://wilsonkumalo.dev/work/neotree-app-updates
- Daredzidzo offline learning: https://wilsonkumalo.dev/work/daredzidzo
- Juvakel recruitment platform: https://wilsonkumalo.dev/work/juvakel
- Fundani School OS: https://wilsonkumalo.dev/work/fundani

## Education and recognition

- First Class BSc (Hons) Information Technology, Chinhoyi University of Technology, 2025
- Vice Chancellor’s Award, 2025
- University Book Prize, 2024 and 2023
